-- w/m.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

type R interface {
	const MarshalJSON() string
}

type T struct{}

func (T) MarshalJSON() string {
	return "x"
}

func main() {
	var r R = T{}
	fmt.Println(r.MarshalJSON())
}
